      • createDemEvent

        @PublishedMethod
IDemEvent createDemEvent(@Nonnull @VDelegatesToWithClosureParam(value=INewDemEventApi.class)
                                           groovy.lang.Closure<?> code)
        createDemEvent(Closure) can be used to create a new Dem event of various types.
        Creating Dem Events
        createDemEvent(Closure) is used to create diagnostic events of different kinds.
        Parameters:
        code - the code (a Closure) used to create a diagnostic event. See INewDemEventApi on how events can be created.
        Returns:
        the IDemEvent create by the given Closure.

      • getDemEvents

        @PublishedMethod
java.util.List<IDemEvent> getDemEvents()
        getDemEvents() returns a list of all IDemEvents in the configuration.
        Accessing Dem Events
        getDemEvents() returns a list of all IDemEvents in the configuration.
        Returns:
        a list of all IDemEvents in the configuration (never null, may be empty)

      • isJ1939Enabled

        @PublishedMethod
boolean isJ1939Enabled()
        isJ1939Enabled() checks, if J1939 is licensed and the J1939Nm module is active in the configuration.
        Check for J1939
        isJ1939Enabled() checks, if J1939 is available in the configuration. This means, that the J1939 feature is licensed and the J1939Nm module is active in this configuration.
        Returns:
        true if J1939 is enabled in the configuration, otherwise false.

        isObd2Enabled() checks, if OBD II is licensed and enabled in the configuration.
        Check for OBD II
        isObd2Enabled() checks, if OBD II is available in the configuration.
        Returns:
        true if OBD II is enabled in the configuration, otherwise false.

      • setJ1939Enabled

        @PublishedMethod
void setJ1939Enabled(boolean j1939Enabled)
        setJ1939Enabled(boolean) enables or disables J1939 in the configuration.
        Enable J1939
        setJ1939Enabled(boolean) enables or disables J1939 in the configuration. This means, that it will activate or deactivate the J1939Nm module. Note, that J1939 can only be enabled, if a valid SIP license was found.
        Parameters:
        obd2Enabled -

        Enable OBD II
        setObd2Enabled(boolean) enables or disables OBD II in the configuration. Note, that OBD II can only be enabled, if a valid SIP license was found.
        Parameters:

      • setOBDMaster

        @PublishedMethod
void setOBDMaster()
        setOBDMaster() enabled the OBD mode for a Master ECU.
        Set OBD mode for a Master ECU
        setOBDMaster() sets the parameter Dem/DemGeneral/DemOBDSupport to the value DEM_OBD_MASTER_ECU.
